paite: Huan Immer tapa, TOUPA' inn a heutupa pen, siampu Pashur in Jeremiah in huai zawlnei thugente agen chih ana za hi.
heading: Jeremiah Leh siampu Pashur Kituahlouhna
english: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in Yahweh’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

paite: Huchi in Pashur in zawlnei Jeremiah akhen a, TOUPA' inn a Benjamin Kongpi saknung a koltanna ah atangsak a.
english: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Azing in Pashur in Jeremiah akhahkhia a, huan Jeremiah in akiang ah TOUPA'N na min ding in Pashur achi kei a, Magermissabib ahon chi zaw hi.
english: On the next day, Pashhur released Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, “Yahweh has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.

paite: TOUPA'N lah hichi in achi ngal a: "Ngai in, nang a ding leh na lawmte tengteng a ding in kihtak in ka hon bawl ding; amau amelmate uh namsau in apuk ding ua, nang zaw na mit in na en lel ding. Judahte tengteng Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka pe vek ding; ama'n Babulon ah sal in api ding a, namsau in athat ding hi.
english: For Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.

paite: Huai ban ah, khopi hauhna tengteng, asepkhiak tengteng, athil manpha tengteng leh Judah kumpipate gou tengteng amelmate uh khut ah ka pe ding a, amau alok ding ua, aman ding ua, Babulon ah api ding uh.
english: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.

paite: Huan nang Pashur, na insung a om tengtengte toh sal ah na tang ding ua; Babulon ah na pai tei ding; huai ah na si ding a, huai ah vui in na om ding a, nang leh na lawm zuauthu na hilhsekte tengteng toh," achi hi.
english: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. You will come to Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.’”

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang na hon khem a, khem a om ka hita ve, nang zaw kei sang in na hat a, na hon zou a; nitum in nuihsan ka hita, mi kuapeuh in ahon nuihsan uhi.
heading: TOUPA Tung A Jeremiah Phunna
english: Yahweh, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded. You are stronger than I, and have prevailed. I have become a laughingstock all day. Everyone mocks me.

paite: Thu ka gen peuhmah chiang in, ka kikoukhia a, hiamgamna leh siatna, chi in ka kikou; TOUPA thu bel kei a ding in, nitum a dem leh muhsit lohna kia ahi.
english: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, “Violence and destruction!” because Yahweh’s word has been made a reproach to me, and a derision, all day.

paite: Amah ka kan kei ding a, amin in leng thu ka gen nawn sam kei ding, chi mah leng, ka guh sung a meikuang kikhum khin bang mai in ka lungtang sung ah a-om a, ka pai kinken zou kei a, ka phazou mahmah kei hi.
english: If I say that I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can’t.

paite: Mi tampi aguk phun uh ka za; kil chih ah lauhuai a-om, hek unla, i hekkhawm ding uh, chi in. Ka lawmte ka puk ding tang gigete'n, "Khem in a-om kha dia, i zou ding, atung ah phu i la kha ding," achi uhi.
english: For I have heard the defaming of many: “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar friends, those who watch for my fall. “Perhaps he will be persuaded, and we will prevail against him, and we will take our revenge on him.”

paite: Himahleh TOUPA mihangsan kihtakhuai mahmah bang in ka kiang ah a-om a, hon simmohte apuk ding ua, ahon zou kei ding uh. Zahlaktak in a-om ding ua, alohchin sin louh ziak un. Tangtawn a aminsiatna uh mangngilh in a-om kei ding.
english: But Yahweh is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They will be utterly disappointed because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which will never be forgotten.

paite: Aw sepaihte' TOUPA, midiktatte enchianpa, lungtang leh lungsim mu paisuakpa, atung ua na phulak hon musak dih ve, ka tungtang thu ka hon kemsakta hi.
english: But Yahweh of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them, for I have revealed my cause to you.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah la sa unla, TOUPA phat un; thil gilou hih mite khut a kipan panpih deihte hinna ahumbitta hi.
english: Sing to Yahweh! Praise Yahweh, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.

paite: Ka piankhiak ni hamsethuak in om hen, ka nu'n ahon piansak ni vualzawl in om dah hen.
english: Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.

paite: Ka pa kiang a, "Tapa na neita," chih thu hon tun a, hong kipaksakmi pen hamsethuak in om hen.
english: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, “A boy is born to you,” making him very glad.

paite: Huai mi, TOUPA'N hehpih het lou a asukgawp khuate bang in om hen, zingsang lam in kikou husa za henla, sun ahih chiang in galdou husa;
english: Let that man be as the cities which Yahweh overthrew, and didn’t repent. Let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime,

paite: sul sung a ahon hihlup louh ziak in; huchi hihleh ka nu ka han himai ding hi a, asul in tangtawn a hon pai ding hiven.
english: because he didn’t kill me from the womb. So my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.

paite: Bangziak a sul a kipan hong pawt chitchiat ka hia, semgim leh lungkham a om ding a zahlak mawngmawng a ka damsung nite zang ding in?
english: Why did I come out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
